purpose: Append-only journal contract for contemporaneous forward decisions and their later outcomes.
invariants: Records are append-only; an observed decision is never rewritten using future outcome.
NO_TRADE is a first-class recorded decision.
Outcome is populated only after the observation window closes.
Historical Winner/Survivor records cannot be imported as forward records.
A journal writer must use a single-writer/atomic append policy.
No live order execution is performed by this journal.
